name: whatsapp-channel
description: WhatsApp channel for Claude Code — choose linked-device messaging or official Cloud API, with built-in access control.

transcription_provider.title: Voice transcription provider
transcription_provider.description: local (default, needs ~/whisper-transcribe.sh), groq, or openai. Leave empty for local.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Only used when the provider is groq. Voice notes are sent to api.groq.com for transcription.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Only used when the provider is openai. Voice notes are sent to api.openai.com for transcription.

connection_provider.title: WhatsApp connection
connection_provider.description: baileys (default, linked device) or cloud-api (official business DMs). Leave empty to use terminal setup.

cloud_phone_number_id.title: Cloud API phone number ID
cloud_phone_number_id.description: Meta phone number ID, not your phone number. Only used with cloud-api.

cloud_access_token.title: Cloud API access token
cloud_access_token.description: Only used with cloud-api. Kept in your keychain when configured here.

cloud_app_secret.title: Meta app secret
cloud_app_secret.description: Validates signed Cloud API webhooks. Only used with cloud-api.

cloud_verify_token.title: Cloud webhook verify token
cloud_verify_token.description: Your chosen callback verification token; enter the same value in Meta. Only used with cloud-api.
